notes: Republican county committee was on the June 2, 2026 primary ballot in every one of Bergen's 563 election districts (one 'For Members of the County Committee, Vote for Two' contest per district on the sample ballots). The county clerk's official district canvass and summary report for the 2026, 2025, 2024 and 2023 primaries do not report Bergen Republican county committee contests at all, so no official results were found and the evidence is the official sample ballots (a candidate listing). The sample ballots do not mark which candidate is running for the male or female seat, so seats are labeled 'Member'. Unknown = a slot with a printed Republican candidate (no result could be verified, so not counted as filled). Empty_no_filer = a slot printed 'NO PETITION FILED' (write-ins could still have won). Where more than two candidates appeared (20 districts), both seats are unknown. The candidate count per district was read from the position of the county committee column on each ballot page; every page balanced to two slots (candidates plus 'NO PETITION FILED'). The district count matches the 563 districts in the official canvass. Precinct names are as printed on the ballot. The county clerk offers a county committee list only on request.
